title: Add explicit XP values for CR-0 creatures
description:
Finding source:
- Fable P2 found CR-0 experience points are underdetermined.
- Some SRD creatures print "0 (10 XP)" while harmless CR-0 creatures are 0 XP.
- Examples noted: baboon, cat, commoner, homunculus, lemure, shrieker, etc.
- The creature kind stores only challengeRating: "0" and no experiencePoints field.
- The field exists on stat-block records, and CR-to-XP table alone cannot reconstruct the 19 CR-0-with-10-XP cases.

Why it matters:
- Encounter XP/advancement tools cannot determine XP for CR-0 creatures from the pack alone.

Acceptance criteria:
- Add source-backed experiencePoints to creature records.
- Correctly distinguish CR 0 creatures worth 10 XP from harmless CR 0 creatures worth 0 XP.
- Reuse/align with the existing stat-block experiencePoints shape if practical.
- Add tests for representative CR 0 (10 XP) and CR 0 (0 XP) creatures.
- Add a gate that round-trips printed creature CR/XP values from source to pack.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #383: printed XP captured fail-closed from every Challenge line; all 317 creatures emit experiencePoints (27 CR-0 at 10 XP, Frog/Sea Horse at 0, source-verified); schema requires the field; creature-cr-xp gate round-trips XP vs the SRD table.
